interpretation: Tomegome tentatively recalls his laps as 29.84 then 30.02 while discussing why lap two is slower without the initial start boost. Sum 59.86 matches his earlier screenshot.
decision: Preserve as tentative same-player split corroboration. The question mark makes this insufficient to populate verified lap columns. No WR promotion or new record row.
